summary: a	The chart shows the etch rate of various materials (Al2O3, HfO2, AlNx, TiN, SiO2) against the activation step duration. The etch rate increases with time for all materials.
q1: For the etching of aluminum based material, does it matter which type of material it is (i.e. nitride/oxide)?
a1: No it does not seem to matter. Both Al2O3 and AlNx have similar etch results.
q2: Based on these results is it possible to have selective ALE, if so, which material can be selectively etched?
a2: Yes it is possible, SiO2 can be selectively etched wrt to all other materials at an activation time of 5 seconds.
q3: Based on this data, can an ALE recipe be developed for TiN?
a3: Yes, there is an increase in etch rate for increasing activation time
q4: Which activation step durations should be applied to have similar etching of HfO2 and Al2O3?
a4: 20 s for HfO2 and 10 s for Al2O3.
